title: A cohort study on patients recieving Bimekizumab with a diagnosis of Psoriatic Arthritis and Spondyloarhritis who underwent FAPI-PET/CT
summary:
We are conducting a longitudinal,  retrospective, observational study to evaluate how anti-IL17A/F therapy with Bimekizumab influences the activation of the mesenchymal cell compartment in the joints and entheses of patients with Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA) or Spondyloarthritis (SpA). We use FAPI-PET/CT imaging to visualize and quantify in vivo mesenchymal activation.

We plan to include 15 patients who are already receiving Bimekizumab as part of their routine clinical care and who have undergone baseline  FAPI-PET/CT imaging during standard clinical management prior to therapy initiation. Each patient will continue their prescribed therapy for at least six months, and will undergo a second PET/CT scan as part of routine follow-up.

By comparing pre- and post-treatment scans obtained during routine clinical practice, we aim to assess the impact of Bimekizumab on mesenchymal cell activity and identify potential predictors of therapeutic response.

interventions.name: N= 20 patients with a diagnosis of either PsA or SpA under therapy with Bimekizumab and who underwent FAPI-PET/CT examination before and after treatment are followed-up retrospectively for a minimum of 6 months.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of PsA according to CASPAR criteria OR Diagnosis of ax-SpA or p-SpA according to ASAS criteria
- Available FAPI-PET/CT examination before starting Bimekizumab Therapy
- Ongoing therapy with Bimekizumab according to clinical practice for at least 6 months after the first FAPI-PET/CT examination
- Availability of a 2nd FAPI-PET/CT follow-up examination after at least 6 months of therapy with Bimekizumab
- Informed consent for the use of the TARDA Database (#334_18 B) must already have been given prior to and independently from the participation to this cohort.
Exclusion criteria:
1)	Diagnosis of any other rheumatological/ immunological disease such as rheumatoid arthritis, SLE, PSS, MCTD, Behcet syndrome or GPA.

2)     History of lymphoproliferative disease or any known malignancy or history of malignancy of any organ system (except for basal cell carcinoma or actinic keratosis that have been treated with no evidence of recurrence in the past 3 months, carcinoma in situ of the cervix or non-invasive malignant colon polyps that have been removed), treated or untreated within the past 5 years prior to enrolment.

3)	Use of any inadmissible medication (e.g. drugs under development or bDMARDs approved for PsA and SpA other than Bimekizumab)
List of admitted drugs alongside bimekizumab:
a)	csDMARD
Leflunomide (e.g. Arava), 
Sulfasalazine (e.g. Azulfidine RA, Pleon RA), 
Methotrexate (e.g. Lantarel, Metex)
and/or
c)	Systemic glucocorticoids with a stable dose of ≤7,5 mg of prednisolone equivalents daily
